results.title: How Tariffs Could Affect EV Prices | Toyota of Denton
results.content:
Electric vehicles (EVs) often rely on global supply chains. When tariffs
increase, production costs can rise significantly, especially for EVs that
depend on non-domestic battery packs or advanced electronics.

## How Tariffs May Influence EV Prices

You may see price increases in areas such as:

Base Manufacturer’s Suggested Retail Price (MSRP)

Trims that include high-end technology packages

Battery-electric models built with internationally sourced parts [...] A tariff is a tax placed on imported goods. In 2025, the U.S. government
implemented new tariffs that directly impact the automotive industry. These
tariffs apply to:

Vehicles imported from countries without favorable trade
agreements

Automotive components, particularly EV batteries, semiconductors, and
electronic control modules [...] In today’s modern automotive market, partnering with a dealership that
truly understands the impacts of tariffs can make a world of difference. At
Toyota of Denton, we prioritize transparency and customer education so you
can make confident decisions, even when external factors like tariffs create
uncertainty. Our team continuously monitors changes in manufacturing
locations, import taxes, and incentives to provide you with real-time
guidance tailored to your needs.
